summary.text: Elizabeth Bennett-Parker is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 39.
The Senate biography lists Elizabeth Bennett-Parker's service in the House of Delegates from 2022 to 2026 and in the Senate since 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Elizabeth Bennett-Parker was born in Alexandria, Virginia.
Elizabeth Bennett-Parker studied at Cornell University (B.A., 2007), the National University of Singapore (Fulbright Fellow, 2010), and the University of London (M.A., 2011).
The biography lists Stephen Parker as Elizabeth Bennett-Parker's spouse.
The Senate page lists Elizabeth Bennett-Parker's committee assignments as Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, Local Government, Privileges and Elections, and Transportation.
